raw_segments.text: Benedict, alas, poor hurt fowl. Now will he creep into sedges. But that my lady Beatrice
should know me and not know me. The prince is fool. Ha, it may be I go under that title
because I am merry. Yea, but so I am apt to do myself wrong. I am not so reputed. It
is the base though bitter disposition of Beatrice that puts the world into her person, and so
gives me out. Well, I'll be revenged as I may."
